provenance.notes: Recovered native source is included with scripts/build-chat-overlay.ps1 and deterministic native rendering tests. Built with x64 MSVCRT WinLibs GCC 16.1.0 and VLC 3.0.23 headers. Overlay scale follows the decoded source resolution, not app window dimensions or DPI. Text, emotes and input surfaces use correct straight-alpha output. The existing keyboard modifier fix is implemented in source. This source recovery is not a full security audit of the controller. The overlay DLL includes the LGPL VLC 3.0.23 Windows GDI output with display-resolution, alpha-correct filtered chat composition; source and license are in native/chat-overlay/quality-gdi and accompany app builds. Controller shutdown joins all workers before cleanup and exits the standalone process on a stalled worker; individual threads are never terminated during shared-state cleanup. Frame headers reject oversized pixel counts before multiplying by the RGBA byte size. The controller uses bounded panel-sized buffers with amortized growth, balances cached DirectWrite references, indexes exact emote codes, and reuses unchanged static chat frames while preserving animation, input and pipe heartbeats. Native regressions cover pixel equivalence, catalog collisions/capacity, failed draws/allocations, reconnects and GDI cleanup. Emote loads and rendered-image cache entries are tied to source generations; obsolete queued loads, failures, successful decodes, and static fallbacks cannot change a replacement entry. The plugin reuses bounded receive storage and preserves immutable picture identity for identical dimensions, alpha and visible pixels; repeated heartbeats retain cached overlay regions. Real named-pipe regressions cover resize acknowledgments, reconnect, clear, malformed and partial input, failed allocations, and outstanding VLC subpictures. The verified VLC 3.0.23 Studio GDI path scales progressive SDR DXVA2 surfaces before display-sized RGB readback, preserves final GDI/chat composition and replay gating, and retains the original converter for unsupported formats or readback failures. Opaque picture layouts are version-gated. Native hardware regressions exercise source color matrices/ranges, crops, fractional resizing, chat, device changes, fallback continuity and retained-picture lifetimes.
